desc:
World of Power is an anime superpower RPG: rise as a hero or a villain, train to absurd power levels and master the powers that make you unstoppable.

🆕 UPDATE: Card synergies, faster Syndicate jobs and a brand-new reward screen!

💪 TRAIN Strength, Endurance, Intelligence and Agility. Every level makes you visibly stronger, from street brawler to city-shaking legend.
🃏 COLLECT anime-inspired power cards, master them to unlock new forms, and combine them for powerful synergies.
📖 PLAY two stories, one for heroes and one for villains, with cutscenes, choices and different endings.
👊 FIGHT in combo-based combat: Syndicate jobs, daily bosses that transform mid-fight, and legendary mentors who teach you new moves.
🎁 EARN coins, chests, gear and titles, and trade with friends.

📱 Plays on PC, mobile and controller.
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to get notified when new chapters drop!
